doc_title_en: Response to realize management conscious of capital cost and share price
doc_title_jp: 資本コストや株価を意識した経営の実現に向けた対応について

key_facts.reason_jp: 持続的な成長と中長期的な企業価値向上を実現するため

summary_en: ROE 5.5% (FY3/26 actual) targeting 5.9% (FY3/27). Operating margin 2.8% (FY3/26) to 3.1% (FY3/27). New three-year plan (FY3/26–28): boneless fish focus, B2B and B2C expansion, Vietnam/Thailand/China exports, supply-chain diversification, working-capital optimization.
summary_jp: ROE 5.5%（FY3/26実績）→5.9%（FY3/27目標）。経常利益率 2.8%→3.1%。新3年計画：骨なし魚中心、B2B/B2C拡大、ベトナム・タイ・中国輸出、仕入先多様化、資金配分最適化。
tag_en: Capital cost management update – ROE 5.9% (FY3/27 target) – Operating margin 3.1% – New mid-term plan FY3/26–28
